## Testing Checklist

- [ ] Run Lighthouse audit after changes

- [ ] Verify Core Web Vitals:
  - [ ] LCP < 2.5s
  - [ ] FID < 100ms
  - [ ] CLS < 0.1
- [ ] Test across browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari)
- [ ] Test on mobile devices
- [ ] Verify bilingual support (de/ro) still works
- [ ] Ensure TinaCMS editing isn't affected
